settings.label: Which AI do you want to use?
settings.help: Google Gemini is free (a free key from Google, no card). Choose OpenAI if you already pay for ChatGPT's API: a little more reliable at busy hours.

settings.label: Business name
settings.help: As your customers know it. Example: Ranime Jemal Agency

settings.label: What your business does
settings.help: One or two sentences the AI uses to write in your name. Example: We build AI automations for small businesses in France and Tunisia.

settings.label: Your brand's voice
settings.help: How you talk to customers. Example: warm, confident, no jargon

settings.label: Default call to action
settings.help: Added at the end of posts when nothing else is planned. Example: Book your free consultation today.
settings.default: Send us a message to learn more.

settings.label: Who approves the posts
settings.help: This person gets the drafts to approve before anything is published.

settings.label: Facebook Page ID
settings.help: On your Facebook Page: About, Page transparency, Page ID. Leave empty if you do not post on Facebook.

settings.label: Instagram business account ID
settings.help: In Meta Business Suite: Settings, Instagram accounts. Leave empty if you do not post on Instagram.

settings.label: LinkedIn company page ID
settings.help: The number in your company page's admin link (linkedin.com/company/12345678/admin). Leave empty if you do not post on LinkedIn.

settings.label: Google Sheet link
settings.help: Create an empty Google Sheet, add the tabs from the guide, then copy the link from your browser's address bar and paste it here.

settings.label: Plan posts this many days ahead
settings.help: Every Monday the AI writes the posts planned for the coming days.

settings.label: Create an AI image for each post
settings.help: On: posts without a picture get one made by AI. Needs OpenAI (Google Gemini makes no pictures, so it stays off with Gemini).

settings.label: Style of the AI images
settings.help: Example: clean, modern, bright photo with natural light
settings.default: clean, modern, bright photo with natural light

settings.label: Reply to comments and messages automatically
settings.help: On: simple questions get an AI reply at once; complaints always come to you. Off: every reply waits for your approval.

settings.label: What the AI may tell customers
settings.help: Opening hours, prices, delivery, services, booking link: anything customers often ask.

settings.label: Sender name on emails
settings.help: The name people see in their inbox. Example: Sarah from Maison Lina
